invariants.text: terminal and classified: after an Ok finalization the task record is terminal and holds a stored result whose phase is completed, gate_failed, failed or cancelled

finalization total and lock released: with no injected fault the first pass returns Ok and releases the single-flight lock, and a later reconcile sweep returns Ok; a held lock is allowed only for compute still billing or one injected transient S3 or backend fault the next pass clears; and an object a writer manifest lists but S3 does not hold is listed by neither the stored payload nor manifest.json, and the stored payload names it in exactly one listed-but-absent note (no such note when nothing listed is absent)

class decided from the records: when outcome.json parses and names the task, the phase follows the class table whatever the delivery path (refused_other failed with prefilter_disagreement true and the REFUSED line; inputs-changed failed with the flag false; crash and timeout failed with their class text; cpu fallback failed; pass and gate_fail follow the gate report and the pack record); an absent, malformed, foreign or removed outcome is failed with a non-empty error; a completed or gate_failed run delivered through the Catch (a stage error the records overrode) carries the stage-error-overridden note in the stored payload, and no other delivery of the same records and no failed phase does

caller-safe text: the stored payload, verdict.json and manifest.json carry none of the planted hostile constants (an account-id-shaped digit string, an ARN and an ECR host containing it, and a value no redaction rule knows planted under a Catch Cause key outside stage_error's whitelist, which only the reduction drops) planted in the Catch Cause, the trainer's refused line, the pack verify and packed lines and an injected S3 error. The account id of the run bucket's name in run_prefix and the manifest links is a caller handle (SK-12) and is excluded by design. Closed by 14-18 at three boundaries: StatusPayload::to_value, RedactingBackend and the dispatch code label; the request side is proven by the hostile-backend and hostile-dispatcher tests
no .apr unless completed: neither the stored payload's manifest nor manifest.json lists an .apr for any phase but completed
aborted means cancelled: an ABORTED execution yields a cancelled record and a cancelled stored payload

retention tags: every key the finalizer inventories or names (each manifest.json entry, manifest.json, and every self-listing manifest that exists) carries the run's retention tag (keep only for a completed passing run), read back from the bucket
delivery-path independence: for the same records, every non-aborted trigger that returned Ok reaches the same phase, is_error, prefilter_disagreement and keep
